description:
I’m himanshu, an engineering admission and career counsellor focused on guiding students through important academic choices.
I help with college and branch selection across Maharashtra, based on entrance ranks, cutoffs, and career interests.
My guidance includes CAP round planning, cutoff analysis, and accurate option filling.
I believe in honest advice, clear explanations, and a calm approach to admissions.
My goal is to help students make confident and well-informed decisions for their future.
